title: Complete non-hostile animals with real-client join repair

Four flyers reuse movement/prediction for flight and landing with medical/containment gates; throw-flight stays separate.
Only monkey/kobold/scurret have one hand and ComplexInteraction; typed equipment and one-hand clients work.
Typed portability, storage and escape preserve creature identity.
Opt-in autonomous retaliation is provoked only; player-controlled melee remains excluded.
Milk, eggs, parrot memory, cleaning and speech use shared live services and native fixtures.

manual_steps: Join normally first: no inside-head view or readiness kick; move/jump/look control the character. Stop on failure without changing profiles/worlds.
Follow MANUAL.md setup/results for models/analyzer, possession, flight/landing, one-hand equipment, custody/escape, milk, eggs, parrot speech and cleaning.
Check original identity and second-player appearance/held items; physical input, prediction feel and native visuals remain manual.
